complexity_assessment.reasoning: Core metrics logic is straightforward (line counting, threshold comparison), but integration with patrol-meta system adds moderate complexity. Multi-part changes (metrics, integration, tests, output) require careful coordination. No production risk (internal diagnostic tool). Estimated 3-4 hours focused work.

skill_rationale.brainstorming: Challenge assumptions about how to measure complexity in bash—true cyclomatic complexity is impractical to calculate, so validate that line count, nesting depth, and function count proxies actually correlate with maintainability pain points before implementation.
skill_rationale.architecture-design (plan): Map where complexity metrics fit into doctor's existing output structure, understand how patrol-meta.sh health data flows, and identify integration touchpoints to avoid duplication and ensure consistent health signals across subsystems.
skill_rationale.architecture-design (design): Design the metrics collection subsystem: data structures for storing analysis results, threshold configuration (1000/1500/2000 line breakpoints), severity mapping, and output serialization that preserves metrics for downstream patrol integration.
skill_rationale.two-stage-review: Multi-part changes (complexity detection logic, patrol integration, test harness, output formatting) need staged review—Pass 1 validates the metrics approach and integration correctness, Pass 2 audits test completeness and documentation accuracy.
skill_rationale.adversarial-quality: Stress-test complexity heuristics against Shipwright's own scripts: identify false positives (legitimately large utilities), edge cases (generated files, vendored code), and scenarios where metrics mislead—ensure suggestions are actionable, not noise.
skill_rationale.testing-strategy: Design comprehensive test coverage: validate metric accuracy against known Shipwright scripts, verify severity thresholds align with actual refactoring benefits, test patrol data integration end-to-end, benchmark performance impact on doctor runtime.
skill_rationale.pr-quality: Organize multi-part changes by logical progression (metrics logic → patrol integration → test suite → output refinement) with clear, small commits so reviewers can evaluate the metrics approach independently from integration details.

review_focus: Accuracy of script size detection—off-by-one errors in line counting or threshold boundaries
Patrol integration data format and compatibility—ensure complexity metrics fit patrol health model without schema changes
Test coverage of edge cases—generated code, vendored scripts, unusual formatting, multi-line comments
Severity threshold calibration—do 1000/1500/2000 breakpoints align with actual refactoring ROI in Shipwright codebase
Performance impact on doctor runtime—avoid O(n²) file scanning or redundant analysis

Thresholds set too loose (no scripts trigger warnings) or too tight (noise that developers ignore)
